basic_meaning: Read rows from a table or a large portion of it
beginner_caution: A scan is not automatically bad.

basic_meaning: Use an index-like access path to find candidate rows
beginner_caution: A lookup is not automatically good.
Visual order may not equal exact engine order.
Row growth can be expected for one-to-many data.

basic_meaning: Order rows for final output or later step
beginner_caution: Large sorts can be expensive conceptually.
Aggregation may process many input rows first.

basic_meaning: Return a limited number of rows
beginner_caution: Limit does not always remove earlier work.
Projection does not mean rows were filtered.

basic_meaning: Store or reuse an intermediate result conceptually

beginner_caution: Preserves rows and may increase row count.
